en: Founded by Ernst Moser. Based in Meuspath, next to the Nürburgring. Has run Audis in the DTM since 2006.
Founded by Bart Mampaey. Based in Mechelen, Belgium. Has run BMWs in the DTM since 2012.
Run by HWA AG from Affalterbach. HWA builds and runs the Mercedes DTM cars. One of two HWA teams in 2013.
Based in Freilassing. Has raced BMWs since the 1960s. Bruno Spengler won the 2012 title with the team.
Hans-Jürgen Abt's team from Kempten. Has run Audis in the DTM since 2000. Mattias Ekström won the title with the team in 2004 and 2007.
The second HWA AG team, entered as EURONICS/Thomas Sabo AMG-Mercedes. Gary Paffett won the 2005 title.
Ernest Knoors' team from the Netherlands. New to the DTM in 2013. Drivers are former Formula 1 driver Timo Glock and rookie Marco Wittmann.
The second Abt Sportsline team. Timo Scheider won the title in 2008 and 2009. Adrien Tambay is in his second DTM season.
Peter Mücke's team from Berlin. Runs Mercedes cars. Both drivers come from Formula 3.
Stefan Reinhold's team from Andernach. Has run BMWs in the DTM since 2012. Martin Tomczyk won the 2011 title.
Keke Rosberg's team from Neustadt an der Weinstraße. First DTM season in 1995 with Opel. Raced Mercedes from 2000 to 2004 and Audi since 2006.
DTM 2013
Carbon-chassis DTM silhouettes: about 480 hp, 1,110 kg and plenty of downforce.

The 2013 DTM cars (Audi RS 5, BMW M3, AMG C-Coupe) corner far faster than Group A saloons but stay well below single-seaters. Fitted with the game's physics model to the 2013 qualifying times, with acceleration at the game's minimum to keep top speeds down.
